subject: Mobile Development
title: Accessibility on Mobile
description: A short lesson to help you apply Accessibility on Mobile.

hook.text: Over a billion people worldwide live with disabilities. Their phones must work for them too.

buildup.text: VoiceOver on iOS and TalkBack on Android read the screen aloud for blind users.

discovery.text: Switch Control lets people with motor disabilities navigate using a single button press.

twist.text: Many apps ship without accessibility support. Custom controls often break screen readers.

climax.text: Accessible apps serve everyone — including users with temporary injuries or situational needs.

punchline.text: Accessibility helps everyone, not just some.

quiz.question: What does VoiceOver do on iOS?
options: Reads the screen aloud for blind users
